t: You are looking at St Jude's Church on Courtfield Gardens in Kensington. It was designed by the architects George and Henry Godwin and built between 1867 and 1870, with the tower and spire added in 1879. George Godwin was also a British architect, journalist and editor of The Builder magazine. The church stands on the northern part of Captain Robert Gunter's estate. The Reverend John Astbury Aston oversaw the project, and John Derby Allcroft, a wealthy glove manufacturer, paid for it. Myers and Sons did the building work.
